findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s1].blocks[0].text: "Якщо в реченні є особова форма й інфінітив"; blocks[1].text: "З інфінітивом і одним займенником знак наголосу не потрібен".
findings.description: The first statement makes the mere presence of a finite verb and infinitive sufficient for both placements; clitic climbing is construction-dependent. For example, Me gusta leerlo does not permit *Me lo gusta leer. The accent statement also overgeneralizes: oírlo retains its obligatory written accent.
findings.suggestion: Explicitly restrict the placement rule to the constructions taught here. Limit the no-accent statement to the illustrated infinitive forms.
